restoration_note: The teaching builds a single sustained correspondence: the body's hidden interior members ↔ the Father hidden in his kingship; the two outwardly-set eyes ↔ the two ships of light (sun and moon) as manifest Radiances; the tongue that speaks from within ↔ Jesus the Radiance sent forth from the Greatness as the revealing member who proclaims both the wound of the Living Soul and her healing. Most gaps are tightly constrained single letters or stock formulas (ⲭⲓ ϣⲟⲁ 'receive honor', ⲟⲩⲁⲛⲍ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'manifest forth', ⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲛⲧⲉ ⲧⲥⲁⲣⲝ 'body of flesh', ⲡⲡⲣⲓⲉ 'the Radiance', ⲧⲙⲛⲧⲛⲁⲟ 'the Greatness', existential ⲟⲩⲛ in parallel clauses) and accept the editor's restorations. The chapter-heading complement at {3} (8 chars) is left unrestorable — though the title-formula 'they being a likeness of …' must complete with a noun pole of the comparison (body / Father / Greatness), no single fill is constrained against the lacuna's length without parallels. {1} is retained with low confidence on the editor's tentative ⲛⲓⲱⲧ 'fathers,' though four-fathers groupings are not standard in the corpus.
